title: Resident repo service protocol, descriptor, watcher frames and policy (v1)
description: Authority for every document the resident service exchanges: client frames, service frames, native watcher frames, the discovery descriptor, the capability token payload and the policy. All documents are closed (additionalProperties false). Texts are always given per language; no language is a default.

Text.description: Texts keyed by language, only the languages the client asked for; at least one.

lane.description: Fairness lane, one per agent or terminal.

implementation.description: Sealed implementation digest the client runs; a host service of another digest refuses with `stale`.

WorkspaceId.description: Twelve hex digits of the canonical worktree root (`worktreeIdV1`).

RevisionId.description: Id of a pinned input revision (`RevisionV1.id` of BUILD/🧊️revision; its sha256 content address). On a request it is the build's previous revision unless `parent` says otherwise; absent means the service pins the current inputs.

cursor.description: Journal cursor the dirty set is valid up to; stored as `journalCursor` of the new revision.

Dirty.description: `DirtySetV1` of the journal: workspace-relative paths changed since `parent`; overflow restages everything.

Pin.description: `PinV1` of BUILD/🧊️revision: the claim that keeps the revision in the store.

root.description: Absolute canonical worktree root; the service opens the workspace lazily from it and checks it hashes to `workspace`.

arguments.description: The resolved arguments of the invocation (`run`, `run-many`, `exec`, ...): the service loads the graph slice that exactly this selection admits and returns it as `slice`.

tool.description: Build tool of the invocation; selects the backend graph policy of the slice.

stale.description: True when the task has to run for the pinned revision.

key.description: The key of the task: the digest of its complete declaration, resolved inputs, environment and the keys of its dependencies. A client records it after the task succeeded; a task whose recorded key equals the key of the plan is not stale.

Plan.description: The closure of the requested targets in topological order (dependencies first); every task depends only on tasks of the same plan.

manifest.description: Root tree digest of the pinned inputs (`InputManifestV1.digest`): equal inputs have an equal digest in every workspace.

cacheHits.description: 1 when the workspace index and the plan came from memory, else 0.

slice.description: Content-addressed document `{graph,generationPin?}` with the graph slice of the requested `arguments`; present exactly when the request carried them.

ServiceStatus.description: ServiceStatusV1: `indexBytes` counts every distinct index once, however many workspaces share it.

HostDescriptor.description: Discovery file of the per-host service, written atomically next to its endpoint.

detach.description: Keep running after the client disconnects (watch-like jobs); default false.

trust.description: exact: events plus fence prove freshness; verify: every request re-proves membership by stat; none: no memo answers.

features.description: Frames beyond the base protocol this service answers; a client must not send one the welcome does not list.

message.description: Refusals carry both languages: the client may have asked for none the service can render.

retry.description: fallback: run the command in-process without the service.

ChangeRow.description: [kind, isDirectory, path]: added, modified, removed, renamed. Kinds are advisory; every row means re-stat the path (a directory row means its subtree).

scope.description: Relative directory whose events may be missing; empty means everything.

Descriptor.description: Discovery file the service writes atomically into its runtime directory; the native launcher reads it instead of probing blindly.

Caveat.description: Conjunctive restriction appended to a capability. Anyone holding a token can add caveats (narrow it) without the key; nobody can remove one.

HostPolicy.description: Authored bounds of the per-host graph service. Every number is an upper bound or a timer.

description.en: How long the allocator keeps freed memory before returning it to the operating system; 0 returns it at once (the service worker's resident size after a settle fell from about 1.5 GB to 1.1 GB). Set in the environment of the service, its slice workers and every child they start.
description.de: Wie lange der Allokator freigegebenen Speicher behält, bevor er ihn dem Betriebssystem zurückgibt; 0 gibt ihn sofort zurück (die residente Größe des Dienst-Workers nach einem Settle sank von etwa 1,5 GB auf 1,1 GB). Wird in der Umgebung des Dienstes, seiner Slice-Worker und aller von ihnen gestarteten Kindprozesse gesetzt.

Policy.description: Authored defaults. Every number is an upper bound or a timer; none is a language or a path.

en.graph: Re-reading the project graph after a configuration change.
en.host-start: Starting the repo graph service for this host.
en.host-wait: Waiting for the repo graph service ({elapsed} ms).
en.host-unknown-workspace: The workspace {workspace} does not match its root.
en.host-stale: The repo graph service runs other code than this client and retires; a fresh one is started.
en.host-unavailable: The repo graph service did not become ready: {reason}.
en.host-started: The repo graph service is running (pid {pid}, {workspaces} workspaces, {megabytes} MB).
en.host-down: No repo graph service is running on this host.
en.host-stopped: The repo graph service has stopped.
en.queued: Waiting for a free slot in the resident service ({position} ahead).
en.replay: Up to date, nothing changed since {since}.
en.resync: Re-proving membership after a gap in the file events ({reason}).
en.stale-implementation: The resident service runs outdated code and will restart; run the command again.
en.busy: The resident service is busy ({inFlight} running, {queued} queued).
en.capability: The capability token is missing, forged or expired.
en.issue-agent: service issue needs --agent <id> (letters, digits and . _ : - only, at most 64): a token belongs to one agent session.
en.issue-ttl: service issue needs --ttl between 1 and {maximum} seconds (default 3600).
en.scope: The capability does not allow the command class {class}.
en.language: None of the requested languages is available.
en.unknown-command: The resident service does not know the command {command}.
en.deadline: The request exceeded its deadline of {milliseconds} ms.
en.environment: The request runs with {key}={value} but the resident service was started with {actual}; running in this process instead.
en.internal: The resident service met an unexpected failure (reference {reference}); try again, the details are in its log.
en.degraded: File events are unavailable ({reason}); every answer is re-proved by stat.
en.service-started: The resident service is running (pid {pid}, {files} files watched, backend {backend}).
en.service-running: The resident service is already running (pid {pid}).
en.service-down: No resident service is running for this worktree.
en.service-failed: The resident service did not become ready: {reason}.
en.host-memory: Service memory: {rss} MB resident (peak {hwm} MB), heap {heap} MB, {objects} objects, {caches} bounded caches.
en.host-slice: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s).
en.host-slice-detail: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} of {total}.
en.host-slice-owners: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} of {total}; running (name, kind, seconds, rows): {owners}.
en.host-slice-owners-learning: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} of {total}; running (name, kind, seconds, rows): {owners}; no memory peak learned for {kind} projects yet ({used} MB assumed, {budget} MB headroom), one at a time.
en.host-slice-owners-waiting: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} of {total}; running (name, kind, seconds, rows): {owners}; waiting for memory headroom ({used} of {budget} MB reserved).
en.host-slice-owners-serial: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} of {total}; running (name, kind, seconds, rows): {owners}; headroom of {budget} MB is below one project ({used} MB), one at a time.
en.host-slice-owners-resumed: Reading the project graph slice ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} of {total}; running (name, kind, seconds, rows): {owners}; headroom of {budget} MB again ({used} MB taken), resuming.
en.host-memory-pressure-psi: The plan was cancelled: the service has been stalled by memory pressure for {seconds} s (processes waited {value}% of the time for memory, limit {limit}%); try again later or ask for a smaller selection.
en.host-memory-pressure-events: The plan was cancelled: the service's memory limit has throttled it for {seconds} s ({value} events per second, limit {limit}); try again later or ask for a smaller selection.
en.host-memory-pressure-free: The plan was cancelled: the host has had only {value} MB of free memory (floor {limit} MB) for {seconds} s; try again later or ask for a smaller selection.
en.host-memory-budget: The plan cannot continue: the service holds {current} MB of its {limit} MB memory limit (safety margin {margin} MB), so it was cancelled to keep the service up; try again later or ask for a smaller selection.
en.host-stalled: The plan was cancelled: the slice load made no progress for {minutes} minutes; the service keeps running, try again later.
en.host-plans: Plans: {total} asked, {hits} from memory, {computed} computed (last {seconds} s, {budget} over budget); owners re-inferred {reinferred}, cut off {cutoff}; capture {files} files, {probes} probes.

de.graph: Lese den Projektgraphen nach einer Konfigurationsänderung neu.
de.host-unknown-workspace: Der Arbeitsbereich {workspace} passt nicht zu seinem Wurzelverzeichnis.
de.host-stale: Der Repo-Graphdienst führt anderen Code als dieser Client aus und tritt ab; ein frischer wird gestartet.
de.host-unavailable: Der Repo-Graphdienst ist nicht bereit geworden: {reason}.
de.host-down: Auf diesem Rechner läuft kein Repo-Graphdienst.
de.queued: Warte auf einen freien Platz im residenten Dienst ({position} davor).
de.replay: Aktuell, seit {since} hat sich nichts geändert.
de.resync: Weise die Mitgliedschaft nach einer Lücke in den Dateiereignissen neu nach ({reason}).
de.stale-implementation: Der residente Dienst führt veralteten Code aus und startet neu; führe den Befehl erneut aus.
de.busy: Der residente Dienst ist ausgelastet ({inFlight} laufen, {queued} wartend).
de.capability: Die Berechtigung fehlt, ist gefälscht oder abgelaufen.
de.issue-agent: service issue braucht --agent <id> (nur Buchstaben, Ziffern und . _ : -, höchstens 64): eine Berechtigung gehört zu genau einer Agenten-Sitzung.
de.issue-ttl: service issue braucht --ttl zwischen 1 und {maximum} Sekunden (Standard 3600).
de.scope: Die Berechtigung erlaubt die Befehlsklasse {class} nicht.
de.language: Keine der angeforderten Sprachen ist verfügbar.
de.unknown-command: Der residente Dienst kennt den Befehl {command} nicht.
de.deadline: Die Anfrage hat ihre Frist von {milliseconds} ms überschritten.
de.environment: Die Anfrage läuft mit {key}={value}, der residente Dienst wurde aber mit {actual} gestartet; der Befehl läuft stattdessen in diesem Prozess.
de.internal: Der residente Dienst ist auf einen unerwarteten Fehler gestoßen (Referenz {reference}); versuche es erneut, die Einzelheiten stehen in seinem Protokoll.
de.degraded: Dateiereignisse sind nicht verfügbar ({reason}); jede Antwort wird per stat neu belegt.
de.service-started: Der residente Dienst läuft (pid {pid}, {files} Dateien beobachtet, Backend {backend}).
de.service-down: Für diesen Arbeitsbaum läuft kein residenter Dienst.
de.service-failed: Der residente Dienst ist nicht bereit geworden: {reason}.
de.host-memory: Speicher des Dienstes: {rss} MB resident (Spitze {hwm} MB), Heap {heap} MB, {objects} Objekte, {caches} begrenzte Caches.
de.host-slice-owners: Lese den Projektgraph-Ausschnitt ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} von {total}; laufen (Name, Art, Sekunden, Zeilen): {owners}.
de.host-slice-owners-learning: Lese den Projektgraph-Ausschnitt ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} von {total}; laufen (Name, Art, Sekunden, Zeilen): {owners}; für {kind}-Projekte ist noch kein Speicherbedarf gelernt ({used} MB angenommen, {budget} MB Reserve), einzeln.
de.host-slice-owners-waiting: Lese den Projektgraph-Ausschnitt ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} von {total}; laufen (Name, Art, Sekunden, Zeilen): {owners}; wartet auf Speicherreserve ({used} von {budget} MB reserviert).
de.host-slice-owners-serial: Lese den Projektgraph-Ausschnitt ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} von {total}; laufen (Name, Art, Sekunden, Zeilen): {owners}; Reserve von {budget} MB unter einem Projekt ({used} MB), einzeln.
de.host-slice-owners-resumed: Lese den Projektgraph-Ausschnitt ({seconds} s): {phase} {done} von {total}; laufen (Name, Art, Sekunden, Zeilen): {owners}; Reserve von {budget} MB wieder da ({used} MB belegt), es geht weiter.
de.host-memory-pressure-psi: Der Plan wurde abgebrochen: der Dienst steht seit {seconds} s unter Speicherdruck (Prozesse warteten {value}% der Zeit auf Speicher, Grenze {limit}%); versuche es später erneut oder frage eine kleinere Auswahl an.
de.host-memory-pressure-events: Der Plan wurde abgebrochen: das Speicherlimit des Dienstes bremst ihn seit {seconds} s aus ({value} Ereignisse pro Sekunde, Grenze {limit}); versuche es später erneut oder frage eine kleinere Auswahl an.
de.host-memory-pressure-free: Der Plan wurde abgebrochen: dem Rechner standen seit {seconds} s nur {value} MB freier Speicher zur Verfügung (Untergrenze {limit} MB); versuche es später erneut oder frage eine kleinere Auswahl an.
de.host-memory-budget: Der Plan kann nicht fortgesetzt werden: der Dienst belegt {current} MB seines Speicherlimits von {limit} MB (Sicherheitsabstand {margin} MB); er wurde abgebrochen, damit der Dienst am Leben bleibt; später erneut versuchen oder eine kleinere Auswahl anfragen.
de.host-stalled: Der Plan wurde abgebrochen: das Laden des Ausschnitts machte {minutes} Minuten lang keinen Fortschritt; der Dienst läuft weiter, versuche es später erneut.
de.host-plans: Pläne: {total} angefragt, {hits} aus dem Speicher, {computed} berechnet (zuletzt {seconds} s, {budget} über dem Budget); Eigentümer neu abgeleitet {reinferred}, abgeschnitten {cutoff}; Erfassung {files} Dateien, {probes} Proben.

MemoryStatus.description: MemoryStatusV1: what the service holds, so a status answers where its memory goes without attaching a debugger: resident and peak pages of the process, the collector's heap and external bytes, the most frequent object types and every bounded cache.

workers.description: The slice workers' own heaps (each worker thread has its own collector, invisible to the main heap figures): the last heartbeat sample of every running worker and its age. Empty while no slice loads.

running.description: False for the last sample of a load that has ended.

PlanStatus.description: PlanStatusV1: what the plans of this service did: how many were asked and answered from the memo, how many were computed, the last computation and what its capture held (files staged, probes cached, files served live).

load.description: LoadStatsV1 of the last computed slice load, as the generation loader reports them: stale facts, closures verified, owners re-inferred, owners cut off by an unchanged node value, and the milliseconds of the verification.
